formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua [Water] and Parfum [Fragrance] are one entry each; normalized one-based positions.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no prominent strong anionic. The earliest cleansing surfactant is Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate (2, mild anionic) with prominent amphoteric co-surfactants Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3) and Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine (4) -> low.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: None material; Cocamide MEA (19) is a foam booster (not a route).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Several light routes: weak refatter PEG-18 Glyceryl Oleate/Cocoate (5), oat peptide (8), late Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (18), light emollient C13-15 Alkane (21), pearlizer Glycol Distearate (14). C2 not met.
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: The only cationic route is late (after salt); no silicone or payload lipid; cleansing-led mild formula could read low.

weightPotential.rationale: All deposition routes are light, weak or late; no silicone or rich lipid.

depositionLoad.rationale: Weak refatter (5), peptide (8), late guar (18), late light alkane (21).

persistence.rationale: No persistent silicone/waxy lipid; light, partly volatile alkane.

resetCapacity.rationale: Mild sulfosuccinate/betaine/sultaine chassis (C6 low) but nothing heavy to remove; complete foaming system.

payload_lipid: C13-15 Alkane (21, light emollient hydrocarbon, late)

excluded: Juniperus Virginiana Oil (12), Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil (13): fragrance oils (6.4)
Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate (24), Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate (25): product-protection UV filters, trace
Propylene Glycol (22), 1,2-Hexanediol (30), Caprylyl Glycol (31): solvents/preservative boosters
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Light, late or weak routes only; no noticeable residue expected.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: four families present, but the guar and the alkane are late (after salt), the refatter is weak and the peptide is a low-persistence film route; no silicone or waxy lipid. Combined residue plausibly below noticeable even with a mild reset.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Mild chassis gives limited reset; the number of light routes leaves a realistic step toward moderate.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only: botanical extracts and peptide, mild chassis; no specialist route stands out (nonspecific).

usageRole.rationale: Default; frequent possible with explicit frequency wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA not met: no E4 comfort or humectant/refatting route in positions 1-5. unlisted_route_candidate:PEG-18 Glyceryl Oleate/Cocoate (5) (similar to listed PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate but not on the closed list). Counter-signal: Parfum at 6 plus fragrance oils.
